sections.contentHtml: The materials, articles, calculators, and tools provided on this website are for general informational and educational purposes only. They do not constitute formal legal opinions, statutory audit certificates, or individualized investment advice.

A formal consulting relationship is established only upon the mutual execution of an official Letter of Engagement (LOE) or Service Agreement detailing agreed deliverables, milestones, and professional fees.

These terms and any disputes arising out of website usage or professional advisory services shall be governed exclusively by the laws of Nepal, with Lalitpur District Court possessing primary territorial jurisdiction.
